title: Refresh-token exchange rotates the stored token; a reused token revokes the chain
asA: operator whose session has been active long enough for the access token to expire
iWant: the flow controller to transparently refresh the stored access token using the stored refresh token
soThat: the session continues without a re-sign-in until the project's session lifetime expires

acceptanceCriteria.description: The refresh-token exchange rotates the stored refresh token: the pre-refresh value is discarded and the provider's new value is stored on the session record.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a session issued from US-10101 whose access token has been marked expired by the test-injected clock and whose stored refresh token is `rt-old`
acceptanceCriteria.when: the next protected-route request triggers the flow controller's refresh path
acceptanceCriteria.then: the flow controller issues a POST to the provider's `tokenUrl` with `grant_type=refresh_token` and `refresh_token=rt-old`; the provider returns a new `access_token` and new `refresh_token=rt-new`; the session record now stores `rt-new` and no other refresh-token value; the pre-refresh `rt-old` is not present in the session record or the audit log

acceptanceCriteria.description: A second refresh attempt presenting the pre-rotation value revokes the session and emits a `refresh_token_reuse` audit event.
acceptanceCriteria.given: the session and refresh-token-rotation from AC-10107-1 have completed and `rt-old` is captured in the test
acceptanceCriteria.when: the test injects a refresh call presenting `rt-old` at the flow controller
acceptanceCriteria.then: the flow controller invalidates the session handle, clears every stored refresh token that shares the same chain root, and emits one structured audit event `oauth2.refresh_token_reuse` carrying the provider id, the session-handle hash, and the detection timestamp; the event carries no token value; the next protected-route request with the original cookie is refused as unauthenticated

acceptanceCriteria.description: A provider that does not return a refresh token on the token exchange is a supported configuration; no refresh-related record is stored.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a mock provider configuration that omits `refresh_token` on the token response
acceptanceCriteria.when: the sign-in completes and the session record is inspected
acceptanceCriteria.then: the session record's refresh-token slot is empty; the flow controller does not attempt a refresh call on any subsequent request against this session; the session's own project-lifetime expiry (per the session-bridge) is the sole grant duration
